name: VRM_DOC_ATTRIBUTES_B_F
description: VRM_DOC_ATTRIBUTES_B_F contains the list of source document and its line attributes and their mapping with the column names in VRM application.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Sequence identifier of an attribute.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document type.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the transaction data view for an attribute.

columns.name: OBJECT_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Name of the attribute provided in the transaction data view. For example, customer country.

columns.name: DESTINATION_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Column name of the Source Document or Source Document Lines table to which the view column is mapped.

columns.name: EXTENSIBLE_ATTR_MAP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the mapping is for an extensible attribute  or not. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: Name of the source product lookup types. The lookup type is used in translating the data extracted from source systems.

columns.name: VIEW_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier for the source application of the transaction line.

columns.name: VALUE_SET_ID
columns.description: Name of the value set that provides possible values for the attributes.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USED_IN_SEGMENT_ASSIGNMENT

columns.name: USED_IN_MEA_RULE
columns.description: Indicates whether the attribute can be used in MEA rules or not. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
